title: Flow: cold streams, operators and collection

videos.script: A suspending function returns one value. The planner has values that keep arriving: sessions read one by one from a log, a timer ticking, a week that changes while the student studies. {{cold}} Flow is the type for that. A stream produced by suspending code, and cold: nothing runs until somebody collects it, and every collector gets its own run from the start. {{ops}} Operators you already know from lists, map, filter and take, now running one value at a time through the whole chain. And take stops the source the moment it has enough. {{terminal}} Terminal operators that turn a flow into a result. {{flowon}} Flow on, which moves the producer to another thread and leaves the collector where it is, and the rule it replaces. {{errors}} Catch, on completion and retry, for a log that was cut short. {{buffer}} And a slow collector, where buffer keeps every value and conflate keeps only the latest.
